notes.title: Bakery Biz Tycoon Full Release!
notes.notes:
How has the game changed over the last year? Comparing the version of the game 0.9.2 from April 2020 with current version 1.0, we will notice many changes in the interface but also in the game mechanics.

[b]Major changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Production control change, now production will stop automatically after reaching full warehouse. I know that it is not much from the technical side, but I think it will introduce more gameplay and make the gameplay easier.
[*] Improved and changed way of creating a new recipe. The quality of the ingredients and the production methods also have a greater influence on the final evaluation of the product.
[*] Store ranges have been added. The size of the reach will depend on the potential of a given store and the level of marketing in a given city.
[*] The functions and the way of presenting data in the field of company finances, production management and marketing have been completely improved and changed.
[*] The side panel with basic information has been almost completely redesigned and improved.
[*] All known bugs have been eliminated, and certainly all those reported to me by players.
[*] Redesigning the levels of office development, thanks to which the player, together with new offices, increases his expansion possibilities. 
[/list]

In the article below, I present how the latest version of the game differs from one of the older versions 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/635807417cf595c0e7e6d6521fa16b497a262431.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/b9ba17db7f526f46f6672b5333b12d08c7c5dc57.png[/img]

The first changes that can be seen are the change of the interface. The lower bar with buttons and shortcuts has been moved to the left side of the screen. Additionally, it was enriched with information on current finances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/c79c4a36f9327fd67f6d235aa47597842f4e3000.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/5a953fa4b67595c891e3cf1640f54df3f79d3dcd.png[/img]

Big changes also apply to the maps of cities. Now the cities are richer, all function buildings have got their icons to make everything more visible. The stores now display their income on the city map. And what, in my opinion, the most interesting is the implementation of the store’s sales range. Thanks to this, now the range of a given store is better visualized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/b43ed77074a3f64ec4a9e2d3a9325dca9badf74c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/90572ab3911c68dbd0e0d765cce667e3bbae1e01.png[/img]

I also finished work on AI. From now on, the competition is buying stores, which will reduce the number of stores available to the player. But there is also the possibility of taking over the competitor's stores, but at a higher price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/6bb3352b5fbb0fc59301bf44de7bc261b350f268.png[/img]

The system of creating a new product has also changed. From now on, the names can be generated randomly, and you can freely shape the product quality, use sliders and decide whether it is higher quality or lower costs and shorter production time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/dc042a18261fcec3926f656683ca84a4212988d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/e047553f9fcd6f15199cb2417c7594262a914fc5.png[/img]


The panels: Company, Production, Shops, Marketing, Contracts have also changed significantly. The panels have been completely changed, all data and indicators have been rearranged and moved to separate tabs. In the Company Panel, I collected all the data about the company, such as production, sales, loans, marketing, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/ee3f17b6c04a54689eaa9633e16f7c344225474b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/5a35b20f05372a9b7d47ccb304d25ebdd33f7a00.png[/img]

The production panel, all data and indicators were also arranged and transferred to separate tabs. Now the data is presented much better. The mechanics of production have also changed, now each product has a separate production process time, the better we want the product, the longer it will be produced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/6d9fd23d9f120b779f85f9381ec6b57447ac554f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/24aafafbab46fadbe70a461147350a74d7e441fc.png[/img]

In other panels, such as stores / sales, marketing or contracts, all data has been arranged and moved to separate tabs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/266c35b6af48d6cf0a7ad81e52d305f20f47c5d7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/966d3c88f8a620e11e0a5a7347d2baa7e6e4b2e3.png[/img]

[h1][b]#From developer[/b][/h1]

I would like to come back to the negative opinions on the day of the game’s release in Early Access. I think most of these opinions were caused by technical issues with the game, such as a bug in the resolution adjustment which caused a lot of gameplay issues. I fixed the problem quite quickly and I keep developing the game. Although the interest in the game is much less than at the very beginning. Still, I plan to finish the title and release it this summer.

notes.title: New patch 0.9.8
notes.notes:
The new patch introduces a completely new interface and a shortcut bar. More readable and intuitive. It improves resolution detection performance and other minor bugs.

[h3][list]
[*] [b]Interface[/b]
[/list][/h3]

New shortcut bar, now placed on the left side of the screen. It is more readable and contains more information, e.g. what profit we make on a given day or week.

A new screen for company, production, marketing, counterattacks and store departments. Now more readable and spread over several tabs to view data.

[h3][list]
[*] [b]Bug fix[/b]
[/list][/h3]
More graphics options and manual resolution change have been introduced. Resolution detection and adjustment of window dimensions to the size of the system resolution have been improved.

[h3][list]
[*] [b]What's next[/b]
[/list][/h3]

The game will probably be released in a similar shape. After correcting any bugs in the game, I plan to release it within a few weeks.

notes.title: What brings new patch, close to 1.0? Devlog
notes.notes:
Hello :)

[h1]What brings new patch 0.99? [/h1]
I decided to add new mechanics to the game. Building the entire production line. Starting from pallets for raw materials supply, through mixer, dough kneading machines, dough forming machines, ovens and packing machines to the warehouse for ready products.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/5ea00f346376fe52869c81fa0ff49ce44f68d0b3.png[/img]

I think that in the initial phase of the game the player will manage the line himself, they will forge the manufactured intermediate to the next machine but with time, as the company develops, the player will be able to hire a manager to automate the line.

More information and details soon :)

notes.title: Time to move on! Yuma city and Patch 0.9.5 is alive
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/e332747ee280887335eb8d7de1f45b2a0bb9ceea.png[/img]
In the new 0.95 patch another new city appeared, Yuma. This city has less potential than Middelton but more than Sandon. The city has 8 stores, a factory, warehouse, bank and new office for the company's headquarters.


[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Factory
[/list]
The factories are now fully functional. From now on, with the development of the company and with greater production needs, you can buy one of the factories located in different cities on the island. Each factory has its potential and provides additional production capacity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/4f6a5c789e34fdefb59e34bffb990804fc077db1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Warehouses
[/list]
The warehouses are also fully functional. If you need more storage space to hold your products, you can now rent warehouses located in different cities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/37aafe295ba4b36c4c5b9a5f3b28289917033fd5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Banks
[/list]
Banks at Bakery Biz Tycoon offer loans and sometimes powerful cash injections. There are two banks in the game in the cities of Middelton and Yuma. Each of them offers different loan offers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/16919f7a2cf61a4eb1bf0f24ba7bce5b141c69a3.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Offices
[/list]
As the company grows, it's worth taking care of the larger office. Now the player can rent another office for his company and thus increase the expansion possibilities of his company.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/927562d92bf46b4ea65428b877ce86984f456830.png[/img]
[list]
[*] HD version
[/list]
From version 0.9.5, the game is fully available in 1920x1080 resolution. Also supports smaller resolutions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/17a8d04c67ebe56484bc78c488c8ebf28ae48929.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/5f14c00219951b3c3e29c2965cb40ac0ae5911c4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/03c041ba7e87783d2dec17df9b901b879c0a2015.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Changes
[/list]
- Each patch also introduces many small changes to the game mechanics. Patch 0.9.5 introduces improvements to the production screen interface. Now, just click the buttons to increase or decrease the volume of production
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/b390a26674a3022aab7be1dba291cc48112b7177.png[/img]

- The new loans screen allows you to monitor the commitments we currently have.


[h1]What's next?[/h1]

All functions and mechanics are already in the game that I planned. But I left some space to add new features to the game. And now the work will focus on improving the interface functioning, introducing new mechanics of creating a new product and production mechanics. And I think we're approaching the full version of Bakery Biz Tycoon 1.0 :)

[h1]What brings new patch 0.99? [/h1]
I decided to add new mechanics to the game. Building the entire production line. Starting from pallets for raw materials supply, through mixer, dough kneading machines, dough forming machines, ovens and packing machines to the warehouse for ready products.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/5ea00f346376fe52869c81fa0ff49ce44f68d0b3.png[/img]

I think that in the initial phase of the game the player will manage the line himself, they will forge the manufactured intermediate to the next machine but with time, as the company develops, the player will be able to hire a manager to automate the line.

More information and details soon :)

notes.title: New patch 0.9.5 coming soon
notes.notes:
By the end of this month a new patch number 0.9.5 will be released, maybe earlier. Currently, the city and new functions are completed but the balance is still being tested. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/e332747ee280887335eb8d7de1f45b2a0bb9ceea.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Yuma city[/b]
[/list]
The new and last (so far) city of Yuma will be a city with more potential than Sandon but smaller than Middelton. There will be 8 stores in this city, a level 1 factory (counting from 0), a bank and a new office building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/4f6a5c789e34fdefb59e34bffb990804fc077db1.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Factories and warehouses[/b]
[/list]
The functions of factories and warehouses are currently based on increasing production capacity and warehouse space. Maybe in time it will also be better to introduce modules into these factories or warehouses. But this could be added as it develops a new interface for factory, company screens etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/37aafe295ba4b36c4c5b9a5f3b28289917033fd5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/29ec9e9eab7d267249b4493c9bac7aff990e0048.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Bank and loans[/b]
[/list]
The Bakery Biz Tycoon game also has a loan system built in, the bank buildings are already active and you can look for the best opportunity to support yourself financially. Loans operate on the principle that banks change the terms of granting loans from time to time, the interest rate and the period for which the loan is granted changes. The player must repay the loan installment plus interest each week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/16919f7a2cf61a4eb1bf0f24ba7bce5b141c69a3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Company offices[/b]
[/list]
The company's offices will increase the company's capabilities, such as the number of loans or the number of concurrent contracts. Over time, plans to introduce modules that, depending on the company's headquarters building, will affect the parameters of our company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/927562d92bf46b4ea65428b877ce86984f456830.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Next updates
[/list]
The next patch will be version 0.9.9, which should be close to the final version. It will be released, but it may contain some bugs and not a good balance and I will work on version in full HD. After tests and opinions, it will implement any corrections and the game should be fully released. However, after the release I plan one more update as needed.

notes.title: Welcome to Sandon, patch 0.8.5
notes.notes:
Today Bakery Biz Tycoon has been updated to version 0.8.5. This is the second major upgrade of the game. The biggest change is the new city and the introduction of a new game mechanics - automatic production. The new map introduces 5 additional stores, 1 warehouse and 1 level 2 factory, which will be functional soon. At the beginning I would like to point out that in the coming weeks another large patch will be released containing the next city "Yuma".

[h1]What's new in patch 0.8.5[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/e8c9b2736142524cf1dcd449844bc381b6674db5.png[/img]

Along with this patch, new cities, Sandon, were built into the game. It is the smallest city in the game, contains 5 stores, 1 warehouse and a level 2 factory. The city has less potential but also store prices are relatively lower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35254519/acf1e80dcd93159519f5688cb820f0bf8914d6b5.png[/img]

Automatic production now allows you to focus on other aspects of the game. And the player's main task now is to adjust the volume of daily production to the needs of the market.

In addition, other production improvements have been introduced. Now the cost will be charged each time production starts. The interface in production has also been changed.

[b]New keyboard shortcuts:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shift + 1 = Company
[*] Shift + 2 = Factory
[*] Shift + 3 = Stores
[*] Shift + 4 = Marketing
[*] Shift + 5 = Contracts
[*] Shift + 6 = Regional Map
[*] Shift + 7 = Middelton City
[*] Shift + 8 = Yuma City (in future)
[*] Shift + 9 = Sandon City
[/list]

In the coming weeks we plan to introduce at least 2 large patches. The first will contain another map, the city of Yuma. The last one will introduce new mechanics to the game, such as improving factories, increasing the capacity of the company's office or using warehouses and banks.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.5
notes.notes:
With the new patch, the game mechanics will change a lot, from now on production will be automatic. Not like before, when production started only with the participation of the player.

In addition, we have introduced several improvements and prepared the game to introduce new maps. I hope to finish the new map in a week. And the next map should appear within a month.

[h1]Patch 0.7.5[/h1]
[list]
[*] Automatic production
[*] Improvment with save game system
[/list]

notes.title: First major game update 0.7.01
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35254519/6ae7519c650cd23c464baf8477a5a9b29066ee77.png[/img]

After hard work, it's finally a pleasure to announce that the first major update is already released. Check the list of changes below.

[b][h1]Patch 0.7.01[/h1][/b]

[b]Added:[/b]

[list]
[*] [h1]Contracts [/h1]
From now on, you don't need to own a store to sell your products. You can enter into contracts and deliver products to other stores.
[*] [h1]Events[/h1]
The island's economy is going through a difficult period which has resulted in greater market fluctuations! Be prepared for this. Events will have a positive or negative impact on the market.
[*] [h1]Stores of Middelton[/h1]
Now it will depend on you whether at the beginning choose a store with a lower rent but low potential or will you risk a store in a better location? After this update, stores now have parameters specific to their location. This affects the amount of rent and the number of customers.
[*] [h1]Customer service[/h1]
The new update adds the ability to increase or decrease the quality of customer service. Increasing the level of quality requires increasing spending on employees and their training, but you can also save on it to reduce the cost of maintaining stores.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [h1]Stores and products[/h1]
Now, to increase the number of recipes that can be produced, the bakery should be expanded. Store improvement now increases potential and attracts more customers.
[*] [h1]Company opinion[/h1]
The mechanics of creating opinions about your company has changed. Aspects such as satisfaction with service quality, completed contracts will also have an increasing impact on opinions about your company.
[*] [h1]Optimization of the game has been improved[/h1]
Improved game smoothness, and in the next updates should be added a feature to support higher resolution.
[/list]

[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Improved database, data storage and loading
- Minor bug fixes in contests
- Improved weekly billing mechanism
- Some bugs have been fixed in the Week Report screen
- Production launch has been improved
- Statistics in the sales screen in stores have been improved
- Improved creation of a new recipe
- And minor bugs

notes.title: Work on a new update 0.7
notes.notes:
I am currently finishing work on the first major update to the game. We expect to finish work by the end of this month.

[h1] What's new will bring an update 0.7.00 [/h1]

[list]
    [*] [b] Events [/b] - will introduce new content to the game that will affect the game environment. Events will be able to influence the economy, trends and the image of the player's company or its products.
    [*] [b] Shops [/b] - each store will have its own individual parameters. Due to its location, it will have more or fewer potential customers, and equipment costs and rent will also depend on location.
    [*] [b] Contracts [/b] - introduce a completely new function to the game. The contracts will allow you to conclude transactions with other stores for deliveries of bread to their stores. Contracts will be concluded for a certain period and for a specific price and minimum product quality. In this way, you will be able to sell without your own stores.
[/list] 

Estimated date: [b] Till the end of this month [/b]

notes.title: DevLog #3 Small update, bugs fixed
notes.notes:
This is the first update after the game's release. This is due to a bug in the game that we did not notice. They may apply only to some players. Some players may have experienced a situation where no button worked or even could not click the "Start" button. What can I only imagine how it can be frustrating.

I hope the new patch will solve this problem. I am still working on it and testing on the game side, but if someone still has a similar problem then can try to [b]disable scaling in the graphics driver panel[/b]. And if other problems occur or the problem persists, please let me know on the community page - so that I can react if something appears. 

The database has also been checked and everything is OK and there should be no problems.

Please, if you have any problems with the game, let me know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1101780/discussions/]community pages[/url].
